'''Brisnell''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was part of a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Some time during his lifetime, he was tortured by a modified [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]].
